tools.name: check_name
tools.description: Checks whether a name/handle is available on 70+ platforms at once: domain names (.com, .fr, .io, .app…), social networks (Instagram, TikTok, X, YouTube…), creative and dev platforms (GitHub, Behance…), e-commerce, freelance, gaming and company registries. Takes 5-15 s on first call (results cached

tools.name: check_domains
tools.description: Checks domain name availability for up to 10 names on chosen extensions (DNS + RDAP registry lookup). Default extensions: .com, .net, .org, .io, .app, .dev, .co, .fr. Supported: .com, .fr, .net, .org, .info, .biz, .co, .de, .uk, .it, .es, .be, .ch, .nl, .eu, .ca, .us, .io, .ai, .me, .gg, .tv, .app,

tools.name: suggest_names
tools.description: Generates common variants of a name (get-, try-, -hq, -app, -studio…) and checks which ones are available as a domain (.com by default). Use when the exact name is taken.
